text_1.label: Association name
text_1.default: Russian Speaking Student Association · USI Lugano

text_3.label: Introduction
text_3.default: A welcoming, non-political community for Russian-speaking students at the Università della Svizzera italiana — open to all who share our love of language, culture, and connection.

text_4.label: Location
text_4.default:
Università della Svizzera italiana
Lugano, Switzerland

text_6.label: About introduction
text_6.default: The Russian Speaking Student Association brings together students who share a language and a curiosity for culture — at one of Europe's most international universities.

text_7.label: About description
text_7.default: Located in Lugano — where Italy, Switzerland, and the world converge — RSSA creates a space to connect, celebrate culture, and build lasting friendships. We are open to every member of the USI community: language is a meeting place, not a dividing line.

text_9.label: First value description
text_9.default: Every event is planned by students, for students.

text_11.label: Second value description
text_11.default: Run entirely on goodwill and student energy.

text_13.label: Third value description
text_13.default: Any USI student is welcome, regardless of background.

founder_quote.label: Founder quote
founder_quote.default: "I founded RSSA because I wanted a place where being Russian-speaking felt like a connection, not an explanation."

text_15.label: Manifesto description
text_15.default: In Lugano — at the intersection of Swiss precision and Mediterranean warmth — we choose connection over division, and curiosity over isolation.

text_20.label: President biography
text_20.default: Completed an undergraduate degree in Finance at Bentley University and is currently pursuing a Master's degree in Finance at USI.

text_23.label: Vice president biography
text_23.default: Currently studying for a Master's degree in Media Management at USI. Drama actor and cinema enthusiast.

text_26.label: Treasurer biography
text_26.default: About to complete his Master's degree in Fintech at USI.

text_29.label: Contact description
text_29.default: The quickest way to stay in the loop is our Telegram channel — every event is announced there first. Follow us on Instagram for highlights, or send us a message directly.

text_38.label: Related initiative description
text_38.default: Independent student initiative · open to all at USI

text_40.label: Footer description
text_40.default: Russian Speaking Student Association at the Università della Svizzera italiana, Lugano. A community open to all USI students.

text_41.label: University disclaimer
text_41.default: This website is managed by a student association. The Università della Svizzera italiana (USI) assumes no responsibility for the content, opinions, or activities presented on this website.
